data.title: Beverly Hills Drive
data.about:
Welcome to Beverly Hills Drive, The most sought-after luxury address in the city. Damac Hills' Trump Estates offers ultra-luxurious seven bedroom Villas with world-class living through a marvelously captivating entrance and crystal-clear lake nearby.

The Beverly Hills Drive is nestled within an enormous plot of land that offers a vast escape from city life but is surrounded by infinite splendor.

location_tile.title: Damac Hills Close to Everything
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description: The Damac Hills community consists of villas, apartments, and other developments. Discover some of the best scenery and infrastructure while enjoying a relaxed and comfortable lifestyle. Dubai Marina, Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, Miracle Garden, Dubai International Stadium, Mall of the Emirates, and Al Maktoum International Airport are all accessible via the network connection.
